purpose: Durable record of every feature that has been evaluated, with its verdict and the evidence behind it. Check this file BEFORE proposing or testing a feature. A feature listed with verdict 'reject' or 'exclude' must not be re-tested unless the 'retest_when' condition is met.

authoritative_evidence.policy: Retain a feature when its omission worsens validation Brier or both locked-holdout proper scores by any positive amount. This zero-threshold directional policy is intentionally more permissive than the strict statistical decision. Strict decisions, uncertainty, point-in-time provenance, and production eligibility remain separately visible.

retention_policy.name: keep_any_positive_out_of_sample_contribution
retention_policy.keep_when: validation candidate-minus-baseline Brier is positive, or locked-holdout candidate-minus-baseline Brier and log loss are both positive
retention_policy.remove_candidate_when: removal improves validation and both locked-holdout proper scores
retention_policy.safety_override: A retained feature with blocked point-in-time provenance is research-only until provenance is repaired; retention is not a profitability or promotion claim.

evidence_grades.A: Independently verified against production artifacts in this repo by reading config/models/*.json or running the split.
evidence_grades.B: Reported by a prior evaluation session following docs/EVAL_METHODOLOGY_BRIEF.md, artifacts exist but not re-verified.
evidence_grades.C: Claimed by a prior session, evidence not located or not reproduced. Treat as unconfirmed.

features.name: elo_probability
features.notes: The only consistently material fitted signal in the five standard production models. Strict leave-one-out evidence supports KEEP for NBA and SOCCER; MLB, NFL, and WNBA remain INCONCLUSIVE.
features.open_question: NBA v4 hits 73.66% calling 88.2% of games on Elo alone, above the NBA favorite base rate. Leakage vs chalky holdout window is UNRESOLVED and under active investigation. Do not build on top of Elo until answered.

features.name: neutral_elo_rating_difference
features.notes: v3 tiered-elo artifacts pass canonical hash validation. Locked backfill metrics verified from esports-baseline-validation.json. All 4 titles (CS2/LOL/Dota2/Valorant) have artifact health VERIFIED.
features.retest_when: After each title has a self-hash-valid exact-version artifact with immutable 60/20/20 evidence generated without settled-ledger tuning.

features.name: tie_aware_elo_rating_difference
features.notes: KBO/NPB tie-aware Elo. Promoted to shadow_qualified 2026-07-22. Artifact health VERIFIED. First picks pending on next daily run.
features.retest_when: Run an exact-version chronological omission comparison against an intercept-only tie-aware baseline without using settled-ledger results for tuning.

features.name: trend_gap
features.notes: Wired into all five standard production models, with near-zero coefficients. The strict result is INCONCLUSIVE everywhere, but the zero-threshold retention policy keeps it for NBA, NFL, and WNBA because at least one out-of-sample cohort improves slightly. MLB and SOCCER are directional removal candidates.
features.retest_when: Never as-is. If retested it must be as a RESIDUAL trend orthogonalized against elo_probability, not the raw EWMA difference.

features.name: defensive_trend_gap
features.notes: CORRECTION OF A PRIOR CLAIM: this feature does NOT explain NBA/WNBA performance. Its fitted coefficients are near zero, and strict leave-one-out evidence is INCONCLUSIVE in both leagues.

features.name: park_factor
features.notes: Material fitted coefficient, but the strict ablation marks it REMOVE CANDIDATE because a static 2025 three-year table is applied retroactively across seasons. Coefficient magnitude does not cure invalid point-in-time provenance.
features.retest_when: Only after season-correct park factors have timestamped point-in-time provenance and the locked chronological ablation is rerun.

features.name: weather_factor
features.notes: The strict ablation marks it REMOVE CANDIDATE because the historical weather cache has no forecast issue time or observed_at timestamp. It cannot support a point-in-time production claim.
features.retest_when: Only after every weather observation has timestamp-valid forecast provenance and the locked chronological ablation is rerun.

features.name: pitcher_era_gap
features.notes: In MLB v5 with a near-zero coefficient. The strict leave-one-out result is INCONCLUSIVE; starter_era_gap is not a valid challenger because it is unservable.

features.name: starter_era_gap
features.notes: UNSERVABLE — do not reinstate under any name. validation.py:1509 _starter_era_gap() reads _load_starter_era_map(), a dict built by replaying HISTORICAL box scores keyed by event_id. An unplayed game is never in that map, so it returns the 0.0 default at serve time. It therefore trains on real ERA and serves as a constant zero: textbook train/serve skew. learned_forward.py:104-112 already documents this and deliberately provides NO provider, failing closed instead.
features.production_incident: mlb-elo-trend-lr-v4 SHIPPED this feature (feature_names: elo_probability, trend_gap, park_factor, starter_era_gap; coefficient -0.0179) and made 100% of the settled live MLB picks in both ledgers. Every one of those 59 predictions was produced by a model whose fourth feature was silently 0.0 at prediction time. Practical damage is small because the coefficient is near zero, but the mechanism is exactly the failure mode. v5 removed it and substituted the servable pitcher_era_gap — so the v4 to v5 change was a BUG FIX, not feature bloat.
features.retest_when: Never. Remove elo_trend_park_starter from FEATURE_VARIANTS so it cannot be selected again.

features.name: starting_pitcher_fip
features.measured_effect: 84% data coverage, zero measurable effect on locked holdout
features.notes: Collinear with the existing pitcher_era_gap. Rejected on evidence, not neglect.
features.retest_when: Only if pitcher_era_gap is removed from the model, which would break the collinearity.

features.name: head_to_head
features.measured_effect: +0.11pp to +0.61pp accuracy across all five sports, every result within ~1 standard error
features.notes: Registered in the feature registry and imported by features/__init__.py but never requested by learned_forward.py. Tested and found to be noise. NFL was untestable at only 10% non-zero coverage.
features.retest_when: NFL only, and only after H2H coverage exceeds 50%. Never retest the other four sports.

features.name: lineup_strength
features.notes: Pure noise. Registered but never wired. Leaving it unwired is empirically correct.

features.name: player_availability
features.measured_effect: 142-game WNBA cohort May 14 - Jul 20: accuracy 71.8% -> 73.2% (+1.4pp), Brier 0.21278 -> 0.20799 (-2.3%), units at -110 +52.73 -> +56.55, zero harmful selection flips
features.notes: Applied as a post-hoc probit adjustment gated at a 5pp threshold, not as a regression feature. Evidence is grade B and was not part of the current exact-artifact strict ablation, so it remains a research KEEP rather than proof of production profitability.
features.open_question: Whether the same availability mechanism transfers to NBA. Untested.

features.name: market_signals
features.notes: ARCHITECTURAL EXCLUSION, not an empirical rejection. The independent outcome model must never consume market price. Wiring this into a sport model would violate market isolation and invalidate every edge calculation downstream.
features.retest_when: Only inside a separately labeled market-residual or decision layer, never in the outcome model.

features.name: guaranteed_signal
features.notes: Not a numeric feature. It is a post-hoc classification tag applied after a prediction exists. Cannot be ablated because it is not an input.

features.name: tennis_surface
features.notes: No active tennis model exists. Tennis is deferred per docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md. Untestable, not rejected.
features.retest_when: If and only if a tennis model is revived.

features.name: confidence_gate
features.notes: Selection/threshold infrastructure, not a model input. Governs called_rate. Not ablatable.

features.name: bullpen
features.notes: One import, never reaches a production feature vector. Genuinely untested.

features.name: schedule_load
features.notes: Two imports, not in any production feature vector. Rest/travel is a plausible NBA/WNBA signal and this is the most promising genuinely untested feature in the repo.

features.name: team_runs
features.notes: Two imports. Supplies pitcher_era_gap. Its other outputs are unused.

features.name: consistency_gap
features.notes: Defined in the elo_trend_full FEATURE_VARIANT but that variant is not selected for any production model.

features.name: hot_cold_gap
features.notes: Defined in the elo_trend_full FEATURE_VARIANT, not selected for production.

features.name: trailing_home_win_rate_30d
features.notes: Part of the elo_trend_adaptive_hfa variant alongside elo_neutral_probability. Research output exists at outputs/latest/mlb-adaptive-hfa-research.json but was not promoted.

corrected_claims.claim: MLB is underconfident; 60% predictions win 75% of the time; Platt scaling would fix it.
corrected_claims.correction: The load-bearing locked-holdout reliability bucket holds 237 of 254 calls at mean-predicted 63.4% vs actual 55.3% — overconfident by roughly 8pp, the opposite direction. No bucket anywhere shows 60% predicted resolving to 75% actual.

corrected_claims.claim: Esports and international baseball have artifacts but were never validated.
corrected_claims.correction: The earlier v2 esports baselines have substantial locked-test results, but the currently configured LOL, CS2, Dota2, and Valorant v3 artifacts fail canonical self-hash validation, are research-state, unqualified, and have no locked metrics. Validation of v2 must not be attributed to v3.

corrected_claims.claim: NBA and WNBA outperform because they added defensive_trend_gap as a third feature.
corrected_claims.correction: Fitted coefficients are -0.013 (NBA) and -0.003 (WNBA), i.e. zero. Their performance comes from Elo and from a high called_rate in leagues where favorites are strong.

corrected_claims.claim: Zero calibration exists anywhere in the project.
corrected_claims.correction: Every production artifact records calibration DIAGNOSTICS under qualification.calibration (slope, intercept, expected_calibration_error). What is absent is an APPLIED calibrator — the serving path uses identity. NBA slope 1.785 and WNBA 1.270 indicate underconfidence; SOCCER slope 0.776 indicates overconfidence; NFL has the worst ECE at 0.1009.

corrected_claims.claim: soccer_form.py, rest_travel.py, and data_sources/pitchers.py are dead code.
corrected_claims.correction: None of those files exist. They were misremembered.
